subject: BrightPath: schedule tech deep-dive & pilot window
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@brightpath.health>, Mike Chen <m.chen@brightpath.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: BrightPath: schedule tech deep-dive & pilot window

Hi Elena / Mike — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from discovery:
- Primary goal: accelerate BrightPath triage & documentation search with a hosted trial to validate retrieval accuracy and throughput for real patient notes.
- Success criteria (tentative): >= 85% accurate retrieval on curated prompt tests, average 95th-pctl latency < 350ms for single-turn queries, and no PII leakage in generation outputs.
- Main stakeholders to include next meeting: Mike (CTO), Elena (product), Data Eng (for access to a sample dataset), and Security/Compliance (for SOC/KMS questions).

Ask: let's lock a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (hands-on demo + pilot scope) to drive to an evaluation kickoff. Proposed windows (PT):
  • Wed May 18: 10:00–11:30 AM PT
  • Thu May 19: 2:00–3:30 PM PT
  • Fri May 20: 8:30–10:00 AM PT

If none of those work, send two alternatives and I'll route calendars. For the meeting we'll: review trial plan, confirm success metrics and data access, and agree on prompt set + evaluation rubric.

Attachments: MAP_BrightPath_v1.pdf (mutual action plan draft), initial_prompt_inventory.xlsx (placeholder prompt inventory to review).

I'll follow up after you pick a slot with a calendar invite and a short kickoff agenda.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@brightpath.health>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mike Chen <m.chen@brightpath.health>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 11:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath: schedule tech deep-dive & pilot window

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the clear recap. 

Thu May 19 2:00–3:30 PM PT works best for our team. Please include our security lead (Laura Park) — I cc'd Mike but will add Laura to the invite once we have the calendar event.

Two quick asks before the meeting: 
1) Can you share SOC 2 Type II evidence (or a redacted report) ahead of the kickoff so our compliance team can review?
2) We have a small sample dataset constraint (no PHI in staging). Is Redwood OK with a de-identified export for the eval?

On Thu we expect: Elena (Product), Mike (CTO), Laura (Security / Compliance), and Samir (Lead Data Engineer).

Thanks — Elena
Elena Ortiz
Director of Product, BrightPath Health
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Ortiz <e.ortiz@brightpath.health>, Mike Chen <m.chen@brightpath.health>, Laura Park <l.park@brightpath.health>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightPath: schedule tech deep-dive & pilot window

Great — Thu May 19 2:00–3:30 PM PT is locked. I'll send the calendar invite and include Laura & Samir. Invite will have an agenda and links to the MAP + prompt inventory.

Regarding your asks: 
- SOC 2: we can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a short compliance pack. I'll upload the material to the shared Drive (link below) and grant view access to Laura — expecting to share by EOD today.
- De-identified export: that's fine. Our standard eval guidelines accept de-identified datasets; we'll provide an ingestion checklist and example transformation notes so Data Eng can validate.

Prep notes for the call (what we'll bring):
- Draft mutual action plan (MAP_BrightPath_v1.pdf) — proposed milestones, roles, timeline
- Prompt inventory + sample test cases (initial_prompt_inventory.xlsx) — please flag any redaction constraints
- Proposed success metric definitions and a minimal benchmark harness to run the first 2 weeks

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_rtExampleSOC2

Attachments included in invite: kickoff_agenda.odt, MAP_BrightPath_v1.pdf

See you Thu — I'll send the invite in 10 minutes.

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.inference>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 16 May 2027 16:32:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: BrightPath: schedule tech deep-dive & pilot window

Internal: Elena confirmed Thu 5/19 2–3:30 PM PT and asked for SOC2 and de-identified data guidance. Actions for us before the invite: 
- Neha: please pull the redacted SOC 2 artifacts we can share and add a one-page summary of encryption/KMS controls. Upload to the Drive link and grant BrightPath view.
- Ben: start a short prompt checklist and assemble 8–12 prompt test cases from the initial_prompt_inventory.xlsx as candidate evaluation queries. Focus on retrieval/recall and hallucination checks.
- I'll finalize the MAP and send the calendar invite with kickoff_agenda.odt attached.

Keep notes in the shared Drive under /BrightPath/KickoffPrep.

Thanks — Rishi
